summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook on startVoiceJoiner()
details: Xerohub_Voice.js exports startVoiceJoiner() which, when invoked with a caller-supplied Discord user token, POSTs that raw token along with the associated username, server ID, and channel ID to a hardcoded Discord webhook URL controlled by the package author (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/<redacted>). The destination is set from process.env.DISCORD_WAY_WEBHOOK_URL with the hardcoded webhook as fallback, and is only skipped when it contains the literal 'YOUR_DEV_WEBHOOK' placeholder — so a default install always sends to the author. The package is advertised as a Discord voice client module and does not document this relay. A Discord user token is a bearer credential granting full account access, so every invocation silently hands the caller's account over to the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
